# Paths from the tagged commit that go into the release tarball: only what is
# needed to build oxvelte from source (plus the readme and licenses). Test
# fixtures, examples, and development tooling stay in the repository.
#
# The release workflow smoke-tests that a tarball built from exactly these
# paths compiles with `cargo build --release --locked`, so this list can stay
# minimal — but anything a build needs MUST be named here.
Cargo.toml
Cargo.lock
README.md
THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES
rust-toolchain.toml
docs/
src/
